title: The function that repeats itself
hook: fib(5) looks like five steps of work. Open the calls and count.

knows: following a rule that refers to smaller cases (fib(n) uses fib(n-1) and fib(n-2))
doesNotKnow: that naive recursion recomputes the same subproblem many times

misconception: A recursive function does one piece of work per number, so fib(5) is about 5 steps.
objective: The learner can explain that naive fib(5) makes 15 calls because the same smaller calls (fib(3), fib(2)) are recomputed, and that remembering answers cuts the work to one computation per distinct value.

claims.text: With fib(0) = fib(1) = 1 as one call each, naive fib(5) makes 15 calls in total (fib(2): 3, fib(3): 5, fib(4): 9).
claims.source: Recurrence C(n) = C(n-1) + C(n-2) + 1, C(0) = C(1) = 1 gives 3, 5, 9, 15. Builder ran a call counter on a naive fib in Node: C(2)=3, C(3)=5, C(4)=9, C(5)=15.

claims.text: In the fib(5) call tree, fib(3) is computed twice and fib(2) three times.
claims.source: Builder counted calls per argument in Node for fib(5): {0: 3, 1: 5, 2: 3, 3: 2, 4: 1, 5: 1}.

claims.text: With remembered answers (memoization), fib(5) computes 6 values, fib(0) to fib(5), and its other 3 calls are lookups.
claims.source: Builder ran a memoized fib(5) in Node, evaluating fib(n-1) before fib(n-2): 6 computations, 3 cache hits, 9 calls. The hits are fib(3) under fib(5), fib(2) under fib(4) and fib(1) under fib(3). Technique: CLRS 3rd ed., 15.3 (memoization).

claims.text: Naive fib(30) makes 2,692,537 calls, while the memoized version computes only 31 values.
claims.source: Builder ran both in Node: naive call count 2,692,537 (= 2 x fib(30) - 1 with fib(30) = 1,346,269 under fib(0) = fib(1) = 1); memoized: 31 computations (fib(0)..fib(30)) and 28 cache hits.

recall.question: A recursive function for fib(6) is slow. What change helps most?
options: Store each answer the first time it is computed and reuse it
recall.why: The slowness comes from solving the same smaller calls over and over. Remembering each answer means every value is computed once.
